Independent bounded verification registration: MED-001; source head 00a4d7f81b47fd96b2a7e4ce3ca8059676697c97; new round 20261011T192958557438Z-gpt-MED-001; branch gpt/MED-001-subgroup-independent-20261011.

Scope: Bounded independent verification of previously unverified subgroup/conditional intervals from existing synthetic CSVs.

Acceptance frozen before execution: All15 raw hashes/header/splits/IDs and11520 rows exact; all30groups+6aggregates numerics within1e-10; group sums consistent; all12 semantic mutants rejected; total verdict fail-closed.

Protocol SHA256: 34527226a6f4a8c39baa1fc6d3bdba75b5e373467397fc854f397cd63c7280b7. Limits: Pure synthetic arithmetic only. Conditional row intervals ignore calibration-set variability; five-seed t4 intervals are rough Monte Carlo summaries. No model/DGP regeneration, calibration refit, clinical or real-population fairness evidence; no causal inference or new medical discovery. Nature primary direct open returned Internal Error and PubMed direct open one-line unavailable content; author-hosted abstract and primary scoping-review abstract were read instead. No full-proof/clinical guideline adjudication; noisy searches cannot establish absence of retraction.

Budget: $0, one CPU, sequential, one execution, total preparation/research <=30 minutes, conservative hard stop 2026-10-11 19:56:51 UTC (preparation started19:26:51 UTC). Preserve all failures. Static independent review and official admission required before launch. No merge/deploy. Candidate draft publication and metadata CI may follow without numerical replay.
